headline: Galy brings cultured cocoa to the US; Oobli and Cosun sugar replacer; FDA opens salt substitutes for bread
summary: Cocoa alternatives reached the market: Galy launched cell-cultured cocoa chocolate in the US and into professional kitchens, putting it in direct reach of Belcolade's chefs and pastry customers.
Start-up Oobli and Cosun Ingredients co-developed a sweet-protein sugar replacer for chocolate, a ready partner or benchmark for sugar-reduced Belcolade lines.
Fibre is the big US bread theme: Grupo Bimbo is adding fibre across its portfolio and Calise and Rudi's launched higher-fibre and protein breads, an opening for Puratos enrichment solutions.
Egg replacement keeps moving, with MOA Foodtech and Espiga I+D partnering on bakery egg replacers and new egg-free muffin research.

Regulatory: an FDA rule lets salt substitutes into 139 standardized foods, including breads and rolls, from 14 December 2026, a sell-in moment for salt reduction; pressure is also building for a federal ultra-processed food definition.
